newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algeria says 100,000 T wheat tender optional.
newsitem.headline: Algeria says 100,000 T wheat tender optional.

text.p: Algeria launched an optional tender on Tuesday for 100,000 tonnes of wheat from the world market to be delivered in the second half of May and early June, an Algerian official said.
The official, speaking by telephone from Algiers, said the tender was not limited to the U.S and/or Canadian markets, but was open to European and other suppliers depending on prices offered.
European traders said earlier that Algeria was seeking to purchase 100,000 tonnes of wheat from U.S and/or Canadian markets in four lots of 25,000 tonnes each.
